title: not color only
rule: Differentiate error from normal field state with color plus non-color cues (outline, weight, icon); do not rely on color alone.

citation.source: NN/g — 10 Design Guidelines for Reporting Errors in Forms (§4, §5); NN/g — Website Forms Usability

pass_when: Error state uses color and at least one non-color cue (outline, weight, icon, or error text).
fail_when: Error is only a color change (e.g. red border or red text with no other cue).
overview: Error state uses color plus a non-color cue such as outline, weight, or icon.
apply_when: Styling invalid fields so errors remain clear without color vision alone.
not_when: Success or neutral highlights that are not communicating validation failure.
agent_hint: Pair error color with outline, weight, icon, or error text — never color alone.
description: Differentiate error from normal field state with color plus at least one non-color cue such as outline, weight, icon, or error text. Color alone fails for users who cannot rely on hue. Apply when styling invalid fields after validation. Fail an error that is only a color change — for example a red border or red text with no other cue.
